items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I was in Pittsburgh at the same time as Erskine Hawkins

ctx.x: she was a very famous orchestra leader. And she had some of the best musicians around in Pittsburgh at the time.

And as I said before, there was an awful lot of music around Pittsburgh. There was the Musicians Club in downtown Pittsburgh. In fact, it was up on the hill, what they called The Hill in Pittsburgh, Wylie Avenue, where all the musicians would hang out when they'd get off their jobs.
